question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.1 | Q1
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Manoj walked 30 metres towards East, took a right turn and walked 40 metres. Then he took left turn and walked 30 metres. In which direction is he now from the starting point?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: East 30 m, then south 40 m, then east 30 m gives a net displacement of 60 m east and 40 m south, so the direction is south-east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.1 | Q2
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West and so on. What will West become?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The mapping is a 135-degree anticlockwise rotation: south-east becomes north and north-east becomes west. Applying the same rotation to west gives south-east (C).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.1 | Q3
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A man walks 5 km toward south and then turns to the right. After walking 3 km he turns to the left and walks 5 km. Now in which direction is he from the starting place?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: Facing south, a right turn is west; after 3 km west, the left turn is south for 5 km. The final position is south-west of the start.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.1 | Q4
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: From his house, Lokesh went 15 km to the North. Then he turned west and covered 10 km. Then he turned south and covered 5 km. Finally, turning to East, he covered 10 km. In which direction is he from his house?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The 10 km west and 10 km east legs cancel; 15 km north minus 5 km south leaves the endpoint 10 km north of home.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.1 | Q5
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Ram started walking towards south. He took a right turn after walking 10m. He again started walking towards southeast after walking 25m. Which direction is he from the starting point?
question_appearances.hold_reason: After the 10 m south leg, a right turn points west. The source then says that after walking 25 m he starts south-east, but gives no length for that south-east leg. Different lengths produce different final directions, so the endpoint cannot be determined.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.2 | Q6
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Starting from the point X, Jayant walked 15 m towards west. He turned left and walked 20 m. He then turned left and walked 15 m. After this he turned to his right walked 12 m. How far and in which directions is now Jayant from X?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The first two turns take Jayant south 20 m, the next left takes him east 15 m, and the final right takes him south 12 m. The east-west legs cancel, leaving 32 m south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.2 | Q7
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Lakshman went 15 km to the West of his house, then turned left and walked 20 km. He then turned east and walked 25 km and finally turning left covered 20 km. How far was he from his house?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The 20 km south and final 20 km north cancel. The west 15 km followed by east 25 km leaves him 10 km east of home.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.2 | Q8
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: K is 40 m South-West of L. M is 40m South-East of L. Then, M is in which direction of K?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: K and M are symmetric south-west and south-east of L, so they share the same north-south coordinate; M lies east of K.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.2 | Q9
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A person walks 4 km towards west, then turns to his right to travel 9 km. He turns towards east and travels 12 km. Finally, he travels 3 km towards south. How far is he from the initial position (in km)?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: Taking the start as (0,0), the legs leave the walker 8 km east and 6 km north. The straight-line distance is √(8²+6²)=10 km.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.2 | Q10
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Rohan walks a distance of 3km towards North, then turns to his left and walks for 2 km. He again turns left and walks for 3km. At this point he turns to his left and walks for 3km. How far is he from the starting points?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The north and south 3 km legs cancel, as do the first 2 km west and the final 3 km east except for 1 km east. The distance is 1 km.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.2 | Q11
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: One evening, Raja started to walk toward the Sun. After walking a while, he turned to his right and again to his right. After walking a while, he again turned right. In which direction is he facing?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: In the evening the Sun is west, so Raja starts west. Three right turns change west to south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.3 | Q12
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: I started walking down a road in the morning facing the Sun. After walking for some time I turned to my left. Then I turned to my right. In which direction was I going then?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: In the morning the Sun is east. Left from east is north, then right returns to east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.3 | Q13
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A man starts his journey facing the sun early morning. He then turns right and walks 2 km. He then walks 3 km after turning right again. Which is the direction he is facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: Starting east, the first right turn faces south and the second right turn faces west.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.3 | Q14
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Ravi in his evening walk travelled towards the sun 3 km, then he turned to his left walked 2 km. He again turned to his right and walked 3 km. Finally, he turned to his right walked another 2 km. In which direction is Ravi walking now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: In the evening Ravi starts west. Left faces south, right faces west, and the final right faces north.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.3 | Q15
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: One morning after sunrise, Vikram and Shailaish were standing in a town with their backs towards each other. Vikram's shadow fell exactly towards left and side. Which direction was Shailaish facing?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: In the morning the shadow points west. West is Vikram's left only when he faces north; standing back-to-back, Shailaish faces south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.3 | Q16
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: One evening before sunset two friends Sumit and Mohit were talking to each other face to face. If Mohit’s shadow was exactly to his right side, which direction was Sumit facing?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: In the evening the shadow points east. For east to be on Mohit's right, he faces north; Sumit, opposite him, faces south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.3 | Q17

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.4 | Q19

question_appearances.independent_explanation: The 6 o'clock direction is opposite the 12 o'clock direction. Opposite north-east is south-west.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.4 | Q20
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A clock is placed at 12 noon its hour hand points towards north east. In which direction does its hour hand point at 1.30pm?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: From 12:00 to 1:30 the hour hand advances 45 degrees clockwise. Starting at north-east, it points east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.4 | Q21

question_appearances.question_statement: A man is facing west. He turns 45 degree in the clockwise direction and then another 180 degree in the same direction and then 270 degree in the anticlockwise direction. Find which direction he is facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: West +45° clockwise = north-west; +180° = south-east; then 270° anticlockwise leaves south-west.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.4 | Q22
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.

Then he goes 30 m towards North and further travels by turning 45o in clockwise direction. In what direction is he travelling now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: After walking north 30 m the direction of travel is north. A 45° clockwise turn points north-east (B).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.4 | Q23
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Vinay started his journey towards north to reach his office. After reaching the office he turned 180o in clockwise direction and then 45o in anticlockwise direction. Which direction is he facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: A 180° turn from north faces south; 45° anticlockwise from south points south-east, which is option B.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5 | Q24

question_appearances.question_statement: Kamal is facing South. He turns 135 degree in the anti-clockwise direction and then 180 degree in the clockwise direction. What direction is he facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: South turned 135° anticlockwise points north-east; a further 180° clockwise points south-west (B).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5 | Q25
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Surbhi is facing East. She turns 100 degree in the clockwise direction and then 145 degree in the anti-clockwise direction. Which direction is she facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The net turn is 100° clockwise minus 145° anticlockwise = 45° anticlockwise from east, which is north-east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5 | Q26
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: My friend is facing east. She turned 120o in the clockwise direction and then 165o in the anti- clockwise direction. Which direction is she facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The net turn is 120° clockwise minus 165° anticlockwise = 45° anticlockwise from east, which is north-east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5 | Q27
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A Water flows west to east and on the way turns left and goes in a semi circle round a hillock and then turns left at right angles.In which direction is the water finally flowing?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The stream turns from east to north, reverses direction after the semicircle to south, then a left turn points east (D).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5 | Q28
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A, B, C , D ,E , F, G and H are sitting around a circular table in the same order for a discussion at equal distances .Their positions are clockwise. If G sits in the north ,then what will be the position of D?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: With G at north and A–H in clockwise order, the next seats clockwise are H at north-east, A east, B south-east, C south, and D south-west. Option C is south-west.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5 | Q29
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Aarti facing north takes a 120 degree turn in anti-clockwise direction. After that she takes a clockwise shift of 90 degree. Now he takes a shift of 135 degree to the clockwise direction. Now in which direction aarti is facing?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The net turn is 120° anticlockwise followed by 90° and 135° clockwise, or 105° clockwise from north. This lies in the south-east quadrant, matching option D.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.5-6 | Q30
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A horse is facing south. It turns 90 degrees in the anticlockwise direction, then turns 180 degrees in the clockwise, Which direction is the horse facing now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: From south, 90° anticlockwise faces east; another 180° clockwise faces west (A).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.6 | Q31
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Rahul put his timepiece on the table in such a way that at 6 P.M. hour hand points to North. In which direction the minute hand will point at 9.15 P.M ?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: If the 6 mark points north, the clock face is rotated 180° from normal. At 9:15 the minute hand points to 3, which is west in this rotated orientation.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.6 | Q32
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A, B, C and D are playing cards. A and B are partners. D faces towards North. If A faces towards West, then who faces towards south?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: A and B are partners and occupy opposite directions. With A west, B is east; D is north, leaving C south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.6 | Q33
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A starts from a point and walks 5kms north, then turns left and walks 3kms. Then again turns left and walks 5kms. Point out the direction in which he is going?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: After starting north and making two left turns, the final facing direction is south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.6 | Q34
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A dog is taken out every evening by the owner whose home is in East. They walk 200 m West, then 500m in the South direction. Which direction should they take to reach home?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: After the walk the dog and owner are west and south of home. Returning requires an eastward and northward displacement, so they head north-east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.6 | Q35
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Nikhil walked 30m towards East took a left turn and walked 20m. He again took a left turn and walked 30m. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The 30 m east and 30 m west legs cancel, leaving the endpoint 20 m north of the start.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.6-7 | Q36
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Daniel went 15 km to the West of his house, then turned left and walked 20 km. He then turned East and walked 25 km and again turned left covered 20 km and again finally turned left and covered 5km. How far was he from his house?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The west 15 m and east 25 m leave 10 m east; the later north 20 m and west 5 m leave a net 5 m east, matching option A's distance.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.7 | Q37
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Mohan walked 30m towards South, took a left turn and walked 15m. He, then took a right turn and walked 20m. He again took a right turn and walked 15m. How far is he from the starting point?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: South 30, east 15, south 20, then west 15 leaves a net 50 m south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.7 | Q38
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Starting from a point S, Mahesh walked 25m towards South. He turned to his left and walked 50m. He then again turned to his left and walked 25m. He again turned to his left and walked 60m and reached a point T. How far Mahesh is from point S and in which direction?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The south and north 25 m legs cancel; the east 50 m and west 60 m leave 10 m west.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.7 | Q39
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Yash starts from a point A and moves 3 m straight then take a right turn and walk 4 m, again take a left turn and walk 5m. Finally he takes a left turn and walk 4m now he is facing north, so in which direction he starts?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The turns are right, left, left, a net left turn. To finish facing north, Yash must have started facing east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.7 | Q40
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A goat walks 10 m towards north, turns to right and walks 15m and again turns to right and walk 20m and then turns to left and walks 10m, and finally turns to right and stop. In which direction goat is facing?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: North → right/east → right/south → left/east → right/south. He is facing south.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.7 | Q41
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Y is in the East of X which is in the North of Z. If P is in the South of Z, then in which direction of Y, is P?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: Set Z=(0,0): X is north of Z, Y is east of X, and P is south of Z. P is south-west of Y, which is not listed; D is correct.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8 | Q42
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Sam go North ,Turn right and again turn right then go to the left .In which direction Sam now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: Starting north, two right turns face south; a left turn from south faces east.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8 | Q43

question_appearances.question_statement: A man walks 10m to the right and then again turns right and walks 10m. Then he takes three consecutive left turn. Every time turning to his left, he walks 5,15 and 15m.How far is he now from his starting point?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: Using any initial heading, the relative route legs cancel to a net displacement of 5 m, so option A is the only matching distance.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8 | Q44
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Kiran performing yoga with his head down and legs up. His face is towards the west.In which direction his left hand will be?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: In a headstand, the body is inverted around its facing axis, reversing the left-right side on the ground plane. Facing west, the left hand points north (C).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8 | Q45
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Village A is south of village B and north of village D, which is in east of village E. Village E is west of village C. Village F is between C and D anywhere. Village F is north east of village G which direction of village G respect of village B?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The statements do not fix B relative to F or G. F is north-east of G, but its relation to B is unconstrained, so G's direction from B cannot be determined.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8 | Q46
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Sarita leaves from home .She walk 25m in North west direction and then 25m in south west direction. Next she walks 25m in south east direction. Finally she turn toward her house. Now in which direction she was moving?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The first three diagonal legs leave Sarita south-west of home. Turning toward home means she is moving north-east (C).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8 | Q47
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A boy goes 6 m north and turns east and walk 8 m. Again he turns to his right and walk 4 m. After this he turns to his right and walks 8 m. How far is he from his starting point?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: North 6, east 8, south 4, and west 8 leave a net 2 m north displacement.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.8-9 | Q48
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: Vivek travelled 12kms West, then he turned left and travelled 8kms. Then he turned left and travelled 12kms. How far was Vivek from starting point?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The 12 km west and 12 km east legs cancel; Vivek is 8 km south of his start.

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.9 | Q49
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A directional post is erected on a crossing, in an accident it was turned in such a way that the arrow which was first showing east is now showing north. A passerby went in a wrong direction thinking it is east. In which direction is he actually travelling now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The east-pointing marker was rotated to point north. Following the marker while mistaking it for east means the passerby travels north (A).

question_appearances.source_id: Distance and Direction for Pre.pdf | p.9 | Q50
question_appearances.shared_directions: Directions: Read the following information carefully to answer the questions that follow.
question_appearances.question_statement: A man goes towards East 5km, then he takes a turn to South-West and goes 5km. He again takes a turn towards North-West and goes 5km With respect to the point from where he started, where is he now?
question_appearances.independent_explanation: The south-west and north-west legs have equal and opposite north-south components; their west components add to more than the 5 km east leg, leaving the endpoint west of the start (B).
